description:
https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc/hushfeed

Hushfeed v0.16.0 gives every settings page a shared layout with AMOLED backgrounds, grouped controls and larger headings. Feature Gate Lab and its editors use the same styling. Light mode and larger text remain supported.

- Page-specific menu icons and active setting counts.
- Native switches and pickers keep their existing behavior and saved values.
- Updated English/German labels and screenshots for every page.
- 156 runtime tests passed locally. The release bundle verified 61 patches and all three DEX payloads.

Target: global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically). Load patches-0.16.0.mpp in Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key. This delivery was checked with offscreen Android views; phone installation has not been verified.
